profile.name: Modbus RTU串口网关
profile.description: 一种通过串口总线（常见为 RS-485）与 Modbus RTU 从站设备通信的工业网关或接口设备。在实验室中常用于把上位机、服务器或控制系统连接到仪表、控制器、远程 I/O 模块和传感器，实现串行现场总线上的数据转发与设备接入。
profile.description_en: An industrial gateway or interface device that communicates with Modbus RTU slave devices over a serial bus, commonly RS-485. In laboratories, it is used to connect a host computer, server, or control system to instruments, controllers, remote I/O modules, and sensors, enabling data exchange and device integration on a serial fieldbus.
